name: ModelVariant820_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant820_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a spinning projectile leaves a model part and flies to the opposing slot while its colour fades in, then bursts there into thirty-two clusters, each flashing an animated spark and scattering eight falling shards that fade and three falling debris sprites, while the ambient level dips during the flight and comes back afterwards); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the shards and debris and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 1 once on the frame the projectile bursts, 2 once the last cluster has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-837 and 934 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
